title: The ONE rule every program needs: progressive overload 📈
caption:
Your body adapts, so you have to ask for a little more: add weight or add reps. Pick a rep range, beat it, then add weight. Do you log your workouts? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 8
first_comment: Do you write your workouts down? 📈
